lines.text: How to get or how do I?
Many learners say: How to get to the station?
Better: How do I get to the station?
Do I! How do I get to the park?

data.wrong: How to get to the station?
data.right: How do I get to the station?

native.tip: Вопрос строим с “do I”: “How do I get to the station?”
native.caption: Ты тоже говоришь “How to get to the station”? 😅 «Как пройти на вокзал?» — вопрос без подлежащего, и английский пытаются построить так же, но нужно “do I.” Правильно: “How do I get to the station?” Послушай Карлоса и повтори! Больше практики — в приложении Lexkite.
native.comment: Ответ: “do I.” Вопрос — how do I. Скажи вслух: “How do I get to the …?” Бесплатный тест для практики здесь: {link}

en.hook: “How to get” is not a question
en.tip: Add “do I” to ask: “How do I get to the station?”
en.caption: Do you also say “How to get to the station”? 😅 In Russian the question has no “I”, so people copy it, but English needs “do I.” Correct: “How do I get to the station?” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
